esmith.idfPath.description: Manually specify the IDF path (used for project initialization and status). Leave empty to use the official ESP-IDF extension's idf.currentSetup. Build and flash are always executed by the official extension.
esmith.monitorBaudRate.description: Serial monitor and verification baud rate.
esmith.flashBaudRate.description: Flash baud rate. Lower it to 115200 if writes time out.
esmith.monitorMs.description: Serial sampling duration for closed-loop verification (ms).
esmith.expectedPattern.description: String expected in serial output. When empty, only crash-free startup logs are required.
esmith.retries.description: Maximum retries after flash or verify failures.
esmith.reflashOnVerifyFailure.descriptio: Reflash when verification fails and retry budget remains.
esmith.closedLoop.serialHint.description: Show a hint with live serial output during closed-loop sampling.
esmith.closedLoop.serialMirror.descripti: Mirror serial lines to the ESmith Serial output channel.
esmith.mcp.port.description: MCP server base port. Occupied ports are tried incrementally.
esmith.mcp.autoRegister.description: Automatically write the project MCP entry only in ESP-IDF projects (.vscode/mcp.json on VS Code, .trae/mcp.json on Trae). Other projects are left untouched; run 'Setup AI' manually if needed.
esmith.mcp.autoRegisterGlobal.descriptio: On Trae, automatically point the global mcp.json esmith entry to the stdio launcher. VS Code uses per-workspace .vscode/mcp.json.
esmith.mcp.timeoutMs.description: RUN_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS written to Trae HTTP MCP config to avoid first-build timeouts.
esmith.agentRules.enabled.description: Allow ESmith to generate Agent rules (.trae/rules on Trae, .github/copilot-instructions.md on VS Code).
esmith.openocd.autoFixTapId.description: Check the OpenOCD target _CPUTAPID before JTAG debug/flash and auto-fix it from esp-config.json when mismatched (e.g. the esp32c3 20260304 toolchain bug).
esmith.openocd.scriptsPath.description: Explicit OpenOCD scripts directory (contains target/ and esp-config.json). Leave empty to search idf.toolsPath and common Espressif install locations.
esmith.openocd.adapterSpeed.description: OpenOCD adapter speed in kHz for JTAG debug and flash (e.g. 1000 or 4000). 0 disables the override. Lower it when USB-JTAG reports buffer overflow.
esmith.agentRules.autoInstall.descriptio: Automatically generate Agent rules in ESP-IDF projects.
